headline_marked: Game Boy Camera experience [[comes to Android]] with Epilogue Flashback app
headline: Game Boy Camera experience comes to Android with Epilogue Flashback app
summary: The app offers a nostalgic camera experience with low-res photos and video
details: The Epilogue Flashback app brings the Game Boy Camera experience to Android and iOS devices. It allows users to take low-resolution photos and videos with various options for palettes, shutter speeds, exposure settings, and more.

The app is free to download on the Google Play Store and offers a mix of physical and digital experiences when synced with the Game Boy Camera hardware. Users can experiment with different settings to capture unique moments.

The Game Boy Camera was originally released in 1998 as an accessory for the Nintendo Game Boy, allowing users to take low-quality photos. The Epilogue Flashback app aims to recreate this nostalgic experience on modern smartphones.
